description: Policy for subprocess invocations of tools that read STDIN when given no input path. ripgrep and the grep family search stdin whenever stdin is not a tty and no path argument is present - which is every non-interactive context: CI, a git hook, an agent session. A gate script that calls them this way either blocks forever on a stdin that never reaches EOF, or silently returns zero matches on one that does. Both turn a gate into something that cannot report. Every such call must pass an explicit search path AND stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL.
